messages:
allegra: FYI canary at 3% traffic for v3.7.4 is showing an error-rate bump, not huge but trending. deploy-bot telemetry shows +5.8pp errors and p95 latency +140ms vs baseline. change window open until 22:00 PST. Do we auto rollback or manual?

deploy-bot: Canary snapshot: errors +5.8pp, p95 latency +140ms, 18/900 requests 5xx, anomaly score 0.47. Auto-rollback not triggered (threshold 0.6).

jay: tagging @allegra - given customer-facing pipelines, I'd lean manual rollback to 3.7.3. We should coordinate comms to support first.

sasha: can we confirm which endpoint(s) are affected? quick grep in logs shows most errors from /v1/generate on region-usw2.

kevin: are those errors user-facing or internal retries? any 4xx->5xx spikes?

allegra: mostly 502/503 from model proxy layer, not client 4xx. A small subset of dedicated customers saw increased errors, support DMed about latency for a partner demo.

sasha: ok, sounds customer-impacting. Recommend manual rollback + pin until we root-cause. Who owns exec?

jay: I can own exec for rollback. Plan: pause canary traffic, pin v3.7.3 for canary pool, then ramp. Steps below.

jay: run: `deployctl route set --pool=canary --version=3.7.3`

jay: then monitor: `deployctl metrics watch --selector=pool:canary --window=5m` and watch p95 + errors.

oncall-bot: Reminder: deploy window ends 22:00 PST. Pager rotation: kevin -> sasha -> jay.

kevin: I'll draft the customer-facing blurb for support Slack and the incident channel. Keep it short: acknowledgement, mitigation steps, ETA for rollback complete (~10m).

sasha: Ops checklist: 1) pin routing 2) clear KV cache if needed `redis-cli del model:kv:*` 3) verify model versions on serving nodes `rdwctl ps -a` 4) observe errors for 10m.

jay: executing now. pausing canary traffic -> `deployctl traffic adjust --pool=canary --percent=0`

jay: paused canary traffic, moving to v3.7.3 pin now.

jay: pinned to 3.7.3, applying route change.

allegra: support blurb posted to #support: "We observed increased 5xx errors for a subset of API calls on v3.7.4 canary. We're rolling back canary to 3.7.3 and monitoring; no action required from customers. ETA 10m." :thumbsup:

kevin: posted to customers-oncall list and sent to partner PM.

sasha: doing KV cache clear now.

jay: verifying serving nodes: all canary nodes report 3.7.3, p95 and error-rate trending back to baseline.

deploy-bot: Canary snapshot post-rollback: errors +0.9pp, p95 latency +10ms vs baseline. No regressions detected.

allegra: ok great. Decision: keep v3.7.3 pinned for canary until EOD, open a follow-up investigation ticket to reproduce 3.7.4 crash scenarios. I'll handle comm to product and legal if needed.

kevin: will update release notes and add rollback rationale: "safety rollback after transient model proxy errors in v3.7.4 canary; investigating."

sasha: creating incident-ticket INC-2479 with logs and node dump.

jay: thanks all. I'll schedule a quick retro tomorrow to decide on rollout pace and whether to adjust auto-rollback threshold. :coffee:
